svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Network layer on region eu-west-1 (City view, INC-2041)
svg.desc: Perspective 3D view of region eu-west-1 at ladder level L1 with the Network layer active. Two virtual networks stand on the region plateau as glass enclosures with hairline edges: vpc prod (10.20.0.0/16) and vpc shared-svc (10.30.0.0/16). Inside each enclosure subnets are floor tiles grouped by zone, public subnets with a solid edge and private subnets with a dashed edge. Compute buildings, database cylinders and a load-balancer gate sit dimmed on their tiles. Security boundaries are thin translucent inner walls: sg checkout-app and sg pg-orders. Gateways are gates in the enclosure wall: an internet gateway, NAT gateway nat-a in Watch at 91 % port allocation, and a private endpoint. A peering bridge joins the two enclosures, a hexagonal transit hub carries spokes to both, and a VPN bridge leaves the plateau towards the on-prem site lon-dc1 with both tunnels up at 38 ms. Flows are particles: checkout to pg-orders is allowed, checkout to psp-api egresses through the NAT gateway, and a denied flow of Failing particles stops at the sg pg-orders wall with a cross: denied tcp/5432 from 10.20.4.0/24 at 1.2k per minute since 12:19, coinciding with the 12:19 config change as a secondary finding for INC-2041. Docked 2D panels for the selected boundary sg pg-orders show a flows table, a denied-flows-per-minute chart with the 12:19 marker and a NAT port allocation chart. A layer legend sits bottom left and the Time Ribbon along the bottom.
